alt.en: A yellow warning sign on a post stands at the center of a gray floor. A dotted orange line runs from a standing document at the front left to the sign, a dotted gray line continues from the sign into an indigo dashed area at the back right, and a curved orange arrow bends from the sign down onto a stack of pages lying outside that area.
alt.zh: 一块黄色警示牌立在灰色地面中央。一条橙色点线从左前方的一份文件通向警示牌，一条灰色点线从牌子继续伸入右后方的靛蓝虚线区域，一条橙色弧形箭头则从牌子弯向该区域之外的一叠纸页。

caption.en: Illustration: a document's dotted route toward a dashed root boundary is bent at a warning sign by a curved arrow onto a file outside the boundary, as the advisory describes the symlink rewrite. It does not depict chrome-devtools-mcp, a tested deployment or an actual overwrite, and it does not show that the fix works.
caption.zh: 示意图：文件的点线路径本应进入虚线标出的根目录区域，却在警示牌处被弧形箭头改道，落到区域之外的一叠纸页上，对应公告描述的符号链接改写。图中不是 chrome-devtools-mcp 的实际部署或测试结果，也不表示覆盖已经发生或修复有效。
